scripts.build: npm run build -w @susi/shared && npm run build -w @susi/api && npm run build -w @susi/collector && npm run build -w @susi/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @susi/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @susi/api" "npm run dev -w @susi/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @susi/api" "npm run start -w @susi/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @susi/shared && npm run test -w @susi/shared && npm run build -w @susi/collector && npm run test -w @susi/collector
